data.body: PRIOR_ART_HIERARCHY cross-reference 2026-05-24: see bug fe3a-a3fb-4523-4ccc PRIOR_ART_HIERARCHY comment for the source-ranking that brainstorm + preplanning's External Command Contract must follow when capturing external-dependency feasibility research. Summary: external authoritative + empirical evidence > internal prior art > inference. Internal prior art is a cross-check signal (does the integration work end-to-end?), not a ground-truth source for invocation patterns (could be propagating latent bugs in dormant codepaths).
